title: How to Share or Find a Saved Wi-Fi Password on Android
html:
You can share a saved Wi-Fi network from Settings: Network and internet, then Internet, tap your network, then Share. The phone shows a QR code, and the other person scans it with their phone to join. You do not need root or an extra app. Seeing the password as text is a separate question, and the answer depends on your phone.

Last updated: 10 Oct 2026. Some of these steps work only on Android 12 and newer, according to Google.

I checked this on a vivo V23 Pro running Android 14 (Funtouch OS 14) on 10 Oct 2026. The menu names in the steps below are the ones Google's help page uses, and they can differ on a vivo phone.

Share the network with a QR code

  1. Open Settings.
  2. Tap Network and internet, then Internet.
  3. Tap your Wi-Fi network, then Share.
  4. Unlock the phone if it asks. The phone shows a QR code.
  5. Your friend scans the code with their device to join.

See the password as text

On my vivo V23 Pro, the Share Wi-Fi screen shows a QR code and a Quick Share button. It does not show the password as text.

If your phone does not show it, look at the router. Many routers have the Wi-Fi name and password printed on a label on the router itself, unless someone changed it. The router's admin page, which you open by typing its address into a browser while connected, also shows the Wi-Fi password if you are allowed to sign in. Only do this on a router you own or manage.

Forget a saved network

Open Settings, then Network and internet, then Internet. Touch and hold the saved network, then tap Forget. Your phone will no longer join it automatically.

Share it safely

  • Only share a network you are allowed to share. If it is your landlord's or your office's, ask first.
  • A QR code gives access to the network, so show it only to the person who needs it, and not in a screenshot you post.
  • If you shared a password with someone who should no longer have it, change the Wi-Fi password on the router.
  • On public Wi-Fi, avoid signing in to important accounts. See do you need a VPN?

What to do next

  1. Use Share to give a guest access with the QR code.
  2. Check what your phone shows under the QR code.
  3. Change the router password if you shared it widely.
